identification: Three Australian George V silver florins on hand-labelled cards: (1) 1915 plain (London mint, card says low mintage, scarce date, full legend, 'Advance Australia' partly readable; stained, around VG), (2) 1917-M, (3) 1919-M (card: low mintage, full Advance Australia, .925 silver). Circulated, roughly F to VG. Matches cloud scan.
